entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Disable old Roslyn SDK pipeline #85123
    .NET 11
  • Move our LSP MEF container to dispose asynchronously #85121
  • Let a language without a Roslyn compilation take part in Live Unit Testing / source-based test discovery (F#) #85116
  • FBA: edits to transitive directives do not trigger project reload #85112

Closed

  • Merge dotnet/roslyn-sdk into dotnet/roslyn #84573
    .NET 11
  • Cleanup DisplayDgml #84684
    .NET 11
  • Debug builds fails with node.Type.IsErrorType() || type.Type.IsErrorType() on invalid use of compound operator in anonymous type declaration #84675
    18.11

Created

  • Test for line endings and long paths #85127

    VSCode

    VSCode

    VSCode

    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Let a language without a Roslyn compilation take part in unit testing #85117
    Community, VSCode
  • Visit left operand conversion in a fast path of nullable analysis #85115

    VSCode, Next

    Area-Compilers, Community, Next
